responsibility: Implements the core symbol_table operations shared by callgraph and varpool nodes. It manages assembler-name hashing and equality, symbol insertion/removal from name maps, alias-chain and visibility-related queries, alignment propagation across aliases, binding-to-current-definition logic, and LTO symbol-table output decisions. This file is the low-level symbol-table implementation beneath higher-level cgraph and IPA passes, distinct from cgraph.cc’s call-edge management.
